# sonarqube_qualitygates (Data Source)

Lists quality gates with their conditions, sorted by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_qualitygates" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ignore_missing` (Boolean) With `name`, return an empty list rather than fail when the gate does not exist.
- `name` (String) Only return the gate with this exact name. Omit to list every gate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `quality_gates` (Attributes List) Matching gates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quality_gates))

<a id="nestedatt--quality_gates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quality_gates`

Read-Only:

- `condition` (Attributes List) Conditions, sorted by metric. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quality_gates--condition))
- `copy_from` (String) Always null: SonarQube does not record what a gate was copied from. Kept for compatibility.
- `id` (String) The gate name.
- `is_built_in` (Boolean) Whether this gate ships with SonarQube and cannot be changed.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default gate for new projects.
- `name` (String) Gate name.

<a id="nestedatt--quality_gates--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quality_gates.condition`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Condition ID.
- `metric` (String) Metric key the condition checks.
- `op` (String) `LT` or `GT`.
- `threshold` (String) Value that fails the condition when crossed in the direction of `op`.
